issue_context.title: REST integration does not handle response encoded in utf-8-sig
issue_context.body:
### The problem

When using the RESTful sensor with a website that encodes using utf-8-sig (i.e., includes a Byte Order Mark - BOM), extracting json attributes doesn't work.

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2021.4.0.dev0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Core

### Integration causing the issue

rest

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/sensor.rest/

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
sensor:
  - platform: rest
    resource: https://emspletnestoritve.azurewebsites.net/Izklopi/SlovenskaBistrica.json
    name: Izpadi elektrike
    json_attributes_path: "$.Izklopi.Izklop[0]"
    json_attributes:
      - RadioObjava
      - DatumOd
      - UraOd
      - UraDo
    value_template: 'OK'
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
2021-03-17 08:42:20 WARNING (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.rest.sensor] REST result could not be parsed as JSON
```


The response from the website seems to be proper JSON. Using curl & jq it seems to work just fine:
```text
$ curl -s https://emspletnestoritve.azurewebsites.net/Izklopi/SlovenskaBistrica.json | jq .Izklopi.Izklop[0]
{
  "ImeTP": "T-272 GLADOMES",
  "SifraTP": "4000497",
  "ImeIzvoda": "T-272 GLADOMES",
  "Enota": "Slovenska Bistrica",
  "Opomba": "REVIZIJA TP",
  "DatumOd": "17.03.2021",
  "DatumOdInt": "20210317",
  "DatumDo": "17.03.2021",
  "DatumDoInt": "20210317",
  "UraOd": "08:00",
  "UraDo": "10:00",
  "RadioObjava": "TP GLADOMES(1979)",
  "Preklican": false,
  "Lat": "46.39019988",
  "Lng": "15.49752966"
}
$ curl -s https://emspletnestoritve.azurewebsites.net/Izklopi/SlovenskaBistrica.json | jq .Izklopi.Izklop[0].RadioObjava
"TP GLADOMES(1979)"
```
So to further diagnose the problem I temporarily modified this line:

https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/9011a54e7f0c8b3a10fc648b9a2bdd8660efb42b/homeassistant/components/rest/sensor.py#L170

to:
```python
                except RuntimeError:
```
Now I'm able to see the exception:
```text
2021-03-17 09:03:04 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.sensor] Error adding entities for domain sensor with platform rest
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/home/phil/repos/core/homeassistant/helpers/entity_platform.py", line 317, in async_add_entities
    await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
  File "/home/phil/repos/core/homeassistant/helpers/entity_platform.py", line 509, in _async_add_entity
    await entity.add_to_platform_finish()
  File "/home/phil/repos/core/homeassistant/helpers/entity.py", line 529, in add_to_platform_finish
    await self.async_added_to_hass()
  File "/home/phil/repos/core/homeassistant/components/rest/entity.py", line 64, in async_added_to_hass
    self._update_from_rest_data()
  File "/home/phil/repos/core/homeassistant/components/rest/sensor.py", line 152, in _update_from_rest_data
    json_dict = json.loads(value)
  File "/usr/lib/python3.8/json/__init__.py", line 337, in loads
    raise JSONDecodeError("Unexpected UTF-8 BOM (decode using utf-8-sig)",
json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Unexpected UTF-8 BOM (decode using utf-8-sig): line 1 column 1 (char 0)
2021-03-17 09:03:04 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.sensor] Error while setting up rest platform for sensor
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/home/phil/repos/core/homeassistant/helpers/entity_platform.py", line 208, in _async_setup_platform
    await asyncio.gather(*pending)
  File "/home/phil/repos/core/homeassistant/helpers/entity_platform.py", line 317, in async_add_entities
    await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
  File "/home/phil/repos/core/homeassistant/helpers/entity_platform.py", line 509, in _async_add_entity
    await entity.add_to_platform_finish()
  File "/home/phil/repos/core/homeassistant/helpers/entity.py", line 529, in add_to_platform_finish
    await self.async_added_to_hass()
  File "/home/phil/repos/core/homeassistant/components/rest/entity.py", line 64, in async_added_to_hass
    self._update_from_rest_data()
  File "/home/phil/repos/core/homeassistant/components/rest/sensor.py", line 152, in _update_from_rest_data
    json_dict = json.loads(value)
  File "/usr/lib/python3.8/json/__init__.py", line 337, in loads
    raise JSONDecodeError("Unexpected UTF-8 BOM (decode using utf-8-sig)",
json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Unexpected UTF-8 BOM (decode using utf-8-sig): line 1 column 1 (char 0)
```
Per the suggestion I then modified this line:

https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/9011a54e7f0c8b3a10fc648b9a2bdd8660efb42b/homeassistant/components/rest/data.py#L64

to:
```python
            self.data = response.content.decode('utf-8-sig')
```
Now it's working fine:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/36015321/111486836-d438a380-8705-11eb-9cd1-082cfa184fd7.png)

It would seem that the REST integration does not properly handle responses from websites that encode using utf-8-sig. Maybe the integration should be enhanced to fallback to utf-8-sig when utf-8 decoding doesn't work, or maybe the decoding should be added as another optional parameter.

review_comments: This will break any situation where the previous default encoding was the right one?

No, not really. `utf-8-sig` is a fallback for normal `utf-8` so it should be safe like this..

This is how httpx decodes: https://github.com/encode/httpx/blob/master/httpx/_decoders.py#L249
